'''Star Tours officers''' managed the daily operations and oversaw the personnel and [[droid]]s of the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency, as well as the operations of the souvenir trading post at the end of a tour. They wore distinctive [[Color|blue]] and orange uniforms.

==Behind the scenes==
Though loosely based on the costumes worn by employees working at the various ''Star Tours'' attractions at [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney]] Parks, these Star Tours officers were first named and first appeared as part of the "Star Tours Boarding Party" action figure set.
